title: Driver-based capacity planning with headroom triggers
objective: Forecast capacity from documented volume drivers and act before utilization of benchmarked sustainable capacity exceeds the threshold.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Per-tenant and per-agent resource isolation
objective: Prevent one tenant, integration or AI agent from exhausting shared capacity through quotas, bounded fan-out and default dedicated databases.
implementing_systems: Managed PostgreSQL per-tenant database (provider not selected)
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Surge load test as release gate
objective: Block release of changes to control-relevant or high-volume paths unless the surge load test passes thresholds on production-scale data.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Performance SLO monitoring
objective: Measure latency and throughput per capability from real users and servers and alert on SLO burn.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Cut-off-aware batch scheduling
objective: Schedule batch work against rail and business cut-offs with alerts before a deadline is at risk, and isolate batch load from interactive use.
